title: AFOSI founding director a devout Catholic; AFOSI behind early Collins Elite

tellings.quote: the founding director of Air Force Office of Special Investigations was a devout Catholic who wanted to go to seminary and suddenly found himself in intelligence.

plain: The founding director of the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, the Air Force's own investigative and counterintelligence service set up around 1948, was a devout Catholic who had wanted to go to seminary and suddenly found himself in intelligence. The researcher Jason Simosa says this without naming a source, linking that office to the early days of a secretive group of officials known as the Collins Elite. He tells it because it would mean religious belief shaped how part of the government first handled the UFO question.
